note: Judged 2026-10-11 by an independent judge. RFC 4555 3.6: "The initiator MAY include these notifications in the same request as UPDATE_SA_ADDRESSES." A MAY whose alternative (a separate request) is also permitted, so the {single-polarity: positive} annotation holds. TestMobikeUpdateCarriesItsAddressList requires both UPDATE_SA_ADDRESSES and NO_ADDITIONAL_ADDRESSES in the decrypted chain of the one INFORMATIONAL request startMobikeRequest sends, so dropping the address notification from that request turns it red. Revert record on mobike.go::startMobikeRequest.
